original_test_intent: Validate each Type 42 Interface Type enum against the approved BMC host-interface design and require the corresponding interface-specific and protocol data to be structurally and semantically consistent across reboot.
original_method: Decode raw offset 04h using the applicable enum/version, reject reserved values, interpret MCTP/Network/OEM branches with required assignments/vendor data, validate following data/protocol bounds and compare with read-only management inventory before/after reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies expected interface/protocol/OEM mappings and approves reboot; raw enum/data validation is automated.
required_inputs: Expected Type 42 interface type per controller
Applicable SMBIOS/DMTF assignment table and Type38 coexistence policy
MCTP assignment or OEM vendor/payload interpretation where applicable
Raw parser/read-only management inventory and reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Do not reset/reconfigure the BMC, network interface, driver or protocol stack.
Preserve raw enum and validate the branch-specific data before judging it.
Reject reserved/unresolved assignments rather than inventing a transport.
Stop on management health loss; no automatic reboot retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode raw interface enum, apply versioned MCTP/Network/OEM/reserved rules, validate related data/protocol lengths/content, correlate the approved interface and diff across reboot.
Report unresolved/reserved, malformed, inconsistent or drifting types without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve interface/protocol design, assignment/OEM interpretation and reboot recovery.
Adjudicate vendor-defined semantics and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot prove offset-04h enum or the associated branch data/protocol records that give it meaning.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw Type 42; emit handle/raw enum/assignment branch/data and protocol bounds/controller mapping plus pre/post result.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Interface Type scope, script and 5/5-minute values remain; no interface configuration is changed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode the raw enum with its governing assignment table, then validate all branch-specific data/protocol requirements and approved controller mapping across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS/DMTF assignment, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and management-inventory versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 42 Interface Type enum, interface-specific data and protocol-record definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw enum, reserved/assignment handling and dependent-data validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects known labels with wrong/malformed payloads, unresolved MCTP assignments, incomplete OEM vendor data and protocol mismatch.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved interface/protocol design and current assignment/OEM policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A consistent declaration does not prove live transport functionality; active protocol testing belongs in a separate approved case.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define OEM interfaces or Type38 coexistence, but must supply vendor semantics and cannot relabel reserved/unassigned values without authoritative evidence.
expected_evidence: Pre-reboot raw Type 42 handles/lengths and Interface Type bytes
Branch-specific data/protocol bounds/content and controller-inventory mapping
Statement that no management interface configuration changed
Approved reboot/management health record and post-reboot semantic diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Interface Type is a defined Type 42 enum; dependent data validation preserves its semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Enum/branch parsing and inventory comparison are fully automatable after approved mapping inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw enum, versioned assignments and dependent data/protocol validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains no-reconfiguration safety while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates assignment/OEM/reboot inputs and formal verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a familiar interface label from passing when its required payload or protocol declarations are malformed or inconsistent.
independent_technical_reasoning: The enum selects a parsing and semantic branch; correctness requires both a valid code and data that satisfies the selected branch for the intended controller.
